What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Rescue In The Clouds (V)]]: left, the image of [[Rescue In The Clouds (V) (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit a41bae9); right, the image of [[Rescue In The Clouds (V) (Errata 3)]] (holotable commit 6489b69). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/rescueintheclouds.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/rescueintheclouds.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
